    AI Overview
    Memorial Day is a federal holiday in the United States observed on the last Monday in May to honor military personnel who died in service. In 2026, Memorial Day is on Monday, May 25. It also marks the unofficial start of summer and often includes a national moment of remembrance at 3 p.m. local time. 
    Upcoming Memorial Day Dates: 
    • 2026: May 25
    • 2027: May 31
    • 2028: May 29
    • 2029: May 28 
    Key Details: 
    • Origin: Originally known as Decoration Day, it was established to decorate the graves of Civil War soldiers.
    • Observance: Flags are flown at half-staff until noon, and many people visit cemeteries and memorials.
    • History: Congress passed the Uniform Monday Holiday Act in 1968, which moved the holiday from May 30 to the last Monday in May to create a three-day weekend.
